point_estimate_vs_inferential_testing.finding: In earlier stages, this constraint was formulated as a naive point-estimate check (if observed \Delta \text{CAGR} \ge -2.0\%, pass; otherwise fail). A point estimate ignores sampling variability and estimation error entirely.
point_estimate_vs_inferential_testing.demonstration_of_flaw: Suppose over 252 sessions, \Delta \widehat{\text{CAGR}} = -1.80\% (-180 bps). Under naive point-estimate evaluation, this passes. However, daily paired return differences between E0 and D2 exhibit standard deviation \sigma_{\Delta R} \approx 0.80\% per day (annualized standard deviation \approx 12.7\%). The standard error of the annualized return difference over 252 sessions is approximately \text{SE} \approx 12.7\% / \sqrt{1} = 12.7\% (or \approx 200\text{--}300\text{ bps} for daily paired differences). A 95% confidence interval spans [-5.7%, +2.1%], encompassing severe true underperformance.
point_estimate_vs_inferential_testing.verdict: Point-estimate acceptance provides ZERO statistical confidence that true long-term drag is bounded at -200 bps.

formal_non_inferiority_specification.null_hypothesis_H0_NI: \mathbb{E}[R_{D2} - R_{E0}] \le -\Delta_{NI} \quad (\text{D2 is unacceptably inferior to E0})
formal_non_inferiority_specification.decision_criterion: Reject H0_NI if and only if the lower bound of the two-sided 90% (or one-sided 95%) HAC-adjusted confidence interval exceeds -\Delta_{NI}: CI_{lower, 95%}(\mathbb{E}[R_{D2} - R_{E0}]) > -0.0200

sample_size_and_power_limitation.finding: Proving statistical non-inferiority within a tight 200-bps margin requires immense statistical power. With leveraged ETF volatility (annualized tracking difference \sigma_d \approx 10\%), achieving 80% power for non-inferiority would require over 1,500 trading sessions (> 6 years).
sample_size_and_power_limitation.governance_classification: Therefore, over a 252-session prospective trial, \Delta \text{CAGR} \ge -200\text{ bps} MUST be classified as an OPERATIONAL RISK-BUDGET HEURISTIC, NOT a statistically validated non-inferiority proof.

owner_decision_gate.recommendation: The owner must acknowledge that passing the -200 bps CAGR drag test over 252 sessions is an operational insurance budget rule, not mathematical proof that D2 cannot trail E0 by more than 200 bps over multi-year horizons.
